messages:
Maya: quick share 437 meet Loki the ferret 9a6 495 he dug a tunnel through my blanket fort and now insists on napping in the cable management tray. posted: loki_tunnel.jpg
Liam: this is ferret-level engineering. literally optimizing for latency to the kibble bowl :joy: 10/10 on the insulation 
Zo: omg that smug face. does he chew cables or is he strictly a tunnel architect? :eyes: 
Maya: tunnel architect. very particular about pathways. he left a tiny 'duct tape approved' paw print on my HDMI.
Dario: caption contest: "When the roadmap says 'refactor cables' and Loki ships it" :shipit: :trophy: 
Ella: will he accept a tiny company sticker on his fort? asking for a friend. also, can we get a gif for slack status rotation?
Maya: gonna try a gif. also low-key worried about cords. any quick ferret-proofing tips?
Zo: double-sleeve cables, elevated power strip, and bribery with treats. ferrets respect snacks.
Liam: ops-bot: hypothetical pet visit rules for a very small, energetic tunnel-digger? Loki would be in a carrier but might need supervised out-of-carrier time.
ops-bot: Reminder: Pet visits require People Ops approval. Small mammals require up-to-date vaccinations where applicable, a secure carrier for transit, and supervision during out-of-carrier periods. Please submit Pet Visit request 72+ hours in advance and include an allergy check.
Maya: thanks @ops-bot. will file. also tiny poll: Loki visit preference? (1) virtual cameo only (2) quick lobby hello in carrier (3) desk cameo with a ferret-proof mat (react 1/2/3)
Dario: 3. Loki deserves a mat and a tiny onboarding doc.
Ella: 1 from me — my inbox is ferret-free for now :sweat_smile: 
Zo: 2, I volunteer to supervise his tunnel demo :raised_hands: 
Maya: love it, thanks team. posting the gif when I can capture Loki mid-snooze.
